availability.note: Mazda AU Build & Price (https://www.mazda.com.au/build/6e/) renders no grade data to automated fetches, and the Mazda AU model page's grade selector is empty; it advertises the 'Mazda 6e E35 GT' from $52,990 driveaway. thebeep (Victoria) lists GT $52,990 and Atenza $55,990 drive-away; zecar offer page (to 31 Dec 2026) and CarExpert price page also list both grades. Two grades, unchanged from held.

listPrice.note: Mazda AU release (17 Feb 2026) pricing table, MLP column (GT $49,990). CarExpert price/specs and quick drive say 'before on-road costs' in words; RACV 'before on-road costs'; zecar (Nov 2026) repeats $49,990 before on-road costs. Same basis as mazda-cx-6e (MLP). Victorian drive-away computed by calc/onroad.js = $52,970; the current $52,990 drive-away (Mazda AU model page; zecar: GT only, to 31 Dec 2026) is at or below that and below RACV's Vic drive-away ($54,938), so it is a campaign absorbing on-roads, not a new list price.

batteryKwh.note: useable 77.0 kWh (EV Database marks it estimated); nominal 78.0 kWh on the same page, which is the 78kWh Mazda AU quotes. Same pack as mazda-cx-6e.

rangeKm.note: Mazda AU: 'Up to 560km (WLTP)'; both grades on 19-inch wheels, same powertrain (RACV). EV Database 348 mi = 560 km. No separate AU-certified figure found.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: Mazda AU release 15.9 kWh/100km combined; RACV says tested under ADR 81/02; EV Database 256 Wh/mi (15.9) incl. charging losses. 77/560x100 = 13.75, 15.6% below; inside the 25% cross-check.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 337L seats up incl. underfloor (RACV); CarExpert says measured to the belt line incl. under-floor storage, matching the to-cover convention. Mazda AU model page says 336L. Excludes 72L frunk.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: RACV: seats folded 678L up to the tonneau cover, 1,074L to the roof. Held row had 1,074 (to-roof); corrected to the to-cover convention used on mazda-cx-6e (956 belt line vs 1,434 roof).

towKg.note: Mazda AU model page: 'braked towing capacity of up to 1,500 kg'; RACV 1,500kg braked, 75kg ball download

warrantyYears.note: 5 years/unlimited km vehicle, unconditional; HV battery 8 years/160,000km (RACV)

insuranceAnnual.note: kept from held research; anchored below mazda-cx-6e-gt ($1,900 at $53,990) and above byd-seal-premium ($1,600 at $52,990), well below tesla-model-3-rwd ($2,400) on Mazda's mainstream dealer/repair network

depreciationCurve.note: Mazda brand convention, identical to mazda-cx-6e; China-built new EV nameplate with no AU resale history, and Mazda has run drive-away campaigns (GT $52,990 DA) within months of the July 2026 launch. Matches byd-seal, close to tesla-model-3 [1,0.73,...].
